title: The crime and punishment of I. G. Farben
subjects: Proces de I.G. Farben, Nuremberg, Allemagne,1947-1948

description.value: The story of the huge chemical corporation, I.O. Farben: its relations with Hitler and the Third Reich, its takeover of the chemical industries of Europe in the wake of German conquest, its use of slave labor in its own Anschwitz-like concentration camp and its ultimate exposure at the Nuremberg trials.
